en.description: Every pattern at once, in two languages: landing, Google sign-in, dashboard, records grid and an interactive map.

landing.headline: Know where every vehicle is
landing.subheadline: Register your routes once and see them on a map your whole team shares.

features.title: Routes on a map
features.description: See every registered route without opening a spreadsheet.

features.title: Any mode
features.description: Bus, rail and truck routes live in the same register.

features.title: One record each
features.description: Add a route in four fields and it is available to everyone.

sk.description: Všetky patterny naraz, v dvoch jazykoch: landing, prihlásenie cez Google, prehľad, tabuľka záznamov a mapa.

landing.headline: Vedzte, kde je ktoré vozidlo
landing.subheadline: Zapíšte trasy raz a uvidíte ich na mape, ktorú zdieľa celý tím.

features.title: Trasy na mape
features.description: Pozrite si každú zapísanú trasu bez otvárania tabuľky.

features.title: Ľubovoľný typ
features.description: Autobusové, železničné aj kamiónové trasy v jednom registri.

features.title: Jeden záznam na trasu
features.description: Pridajte trasu v štyroch poliach a majú ju všetci.
